zin_deep_blame_answered = {
	# Scope: a western hold. Its blame of Kunhrim is settled; the moot's condition holds once every standing western hold has settled.
	set_country_flag = zin_deep_blame_answered
	remove_opinion_modifier = { target = KUN modifier = zin_opinion_old_blame }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					country_exists = BRU
				}
				BRU = {
					has_country_flag = zin_deep_blame_answered
				}
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					country_exists = GRO
				}
				GRO = {
					has_country_flag = zin_deep_blame_answered
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_deep_blame_settled
	}
}

zin_deep_cast_vote = {
	# Scope: a hold voting (zin_deep.157). zin_arg_caller 1 for the caller of the moot, 0 for the largest hold. The fourth vote crowns the Deep King.
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_deep_votes_cast = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_caller = 1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_deep_votes_caller = 1 }
	}
	clear_variable = zin_arg_caller
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_deep_votes_cast > 3.99 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_deep_votes_caller > 1.99 }
			}
			var:global.zin_deep_moot_caller = {
				zin_deep_crown_deep_king = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			var:global.zin_deep_largest_hold = {
				zin_deep_crown_deep_king = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	# A find: the count of finds rises; the clans gather where it lies. A Cold Lands crown's third find in the Frozen Lands is the king's hall.
	add_to_variable = { zin_deep_finds = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_deep_finds_made = 1 }
	set_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_open
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_state_flag = zin_deep_site_frozen_lands
				has_state_flag = zin_deep_site_far_ice
			}
			NOT = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_deep_ice_find }
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_deep_ice_find }
		set_variable = { global.zin_deep_last_find_state = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_deep_is_cold_crown = yes
			check_variable = { zin_deep_finds_made > 2.99 }
			NOT = {
				has_global_flag = zin_deep_hearth_found
			}
			any_owned_state = {
				has_state_flag = zin_deep_site_frozen_lands
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_deep_hearth_found
		set_country_flag = zin_deep_hearth_stone
		add_ideas = zin_deep_relic_hearth_stone
		set_variable = { global.zin_deep_hearth_holder = THIS }
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = zin_deep_site_frozen_lands
			}
			set_variable = { global.zin_deep_hearth_state = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				original_tag = MLK
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_deep_hearth_melkgard
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_deep.262 }
		every_neighbor_country = {
			country_event = { id = zin_deep.262 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = zin_deep.251 }
	}
}
zin_deep_kalioth_falls = {
	# Scope: the wearer who paid the Old Tribute when Volgan's body is destroyed (zin_deep.108): the mine-lords rise, the crown's claims are lost.
	save_event_target_as = zin_deep_claimant
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.zin_deep_plutondo_valley_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_claimed_by = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
			}
			remove_state_claim = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.zin_deep_miaed_passes_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_claimed_by = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
			}
			remove_state_claim = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.zin_deep_pornivior_road_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_claimed_by = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
			}
			remove_state_claim = event_target:zin_deep_claimant
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = zin_deep_relic_diadem
		}
		remove_ideas = zin_deep_relic_diadem
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = zin_deep_kalioth_crown_spirit
		}
		remove_ideas = zin_deep_kalioth_crown_spirit
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_deep_kalioth_crown
		}
		drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
		clr_country_flag = zin_deep_kalioth_crown
	}
	clr_country_flag = zin_deep_diadem_worn
	add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_deep_mine_lords_rise days = 365 }
	var:global.zin_deep_site_kalioth_halls = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
			}
			add_resistance = 30
		}
	}
	country_event = { id = zin_deep.108 }
}

zin_deep_moot_answer = {
	# Scope: a hold answering the Road Moot (zin_deep.155). zin_arg_came 1 comes, 0 stays away. When the three have answered the moot sits or fails.
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_deep_moot_answers = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_came = 1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_deep_moot_came = 1 }
	}
	clear_variable = zin_arg_came
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_deep_moot_answers > 2.99 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_deep_moot_came > 2.99 }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_deep_road_moot
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = zin_deep_moot_called
			var:global.zin_deep_moot_caller = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_deep_moot_failed days = 365 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = KUN
			}
			KUN = {
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.156 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = HRA
			}
			HRA = {
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.156 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = BRU
			}
			BRU = {
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.156 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = GRO
			}
			GRO = {
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.156 }
			}
		}
	}

				has_global_flag = zin_deep_deep_crisis
			}
			zin_deep_tell_the_deep = yes
		}
	}
	# The Grey Breath: a chance each month to reach a neighbour's port; it passes when its season ends.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_deep_breath_active
			has_global_flag = zin_deep_grey_breath
		}
		clear_array = global.zin_deep_breath_new
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.zin_deep_breath_states
			random_list = {
				15 = {
					random_neighbor_state = {
						limit = {
							is_coastal = yes
							NOT = {
								has_state_flag = zin_deep_breath
							}
						}
						add_to_array = { global.zin_deep_breath_new = THIS }
					}
				}
				85 = {

				}
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.zin_deep_breath_new
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_state_flag = zin_deep_breath
					}
				}
				zin_deep_breath_state = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_deep_breath_active
			NOT = {
				has_global_flag = zin_deep_grey_breath
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = zin_deep_breath_active
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.zin_deep_breath_states
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_deep_grey_breath }
			clr_state_flag = zin_deep_breath
		}
		clear_array = global.zin_deep_breath_states
		var:global.zin_deep_relighter = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.212 }
			}
		}
	}
	# The ice: the first Long Light after a mild winter tells the walkers that the ice gives things back.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_deep_long_light = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = CLD
				CLD = {
					zin_deep_owns_ice_state = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_open
					}
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
					}
				}
			}
			CLD = {
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
				zin_deep_open_ice = yes
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.250 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = KVI
				KVI = {
					zin_deep_owns_ice_state = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_open
					}
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
					}
				}
			}
			KVI = {
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
				zin_deep_open_ice = yes
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.250 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = HOR
				HOR = {
					zin_deep_owns_ice_state = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_open
					}
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
					}
				}
			}
			HOR = {
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
				zin_deep_open_ice = yes
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.250 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = FEA
				FEA = {
					zin_deep_owns_ice_state = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_open
					}
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
					}
				}
			}
			FEA = {
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
				zin_deep_open_ice = yes
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.250 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = MLK
				MLK = {
					zin_deep_owns_ice_state = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_open
					}
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
					}
				}
			}
			MLK = {
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_ice_heard
				zin_deep_open_ice = yes
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.250 }
			}
		}
	}
	# The hearth-stone changes hands with the state where it is kept, when a Cold Lands crown takes that state.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_deep_hearth_found
			var:global.zin_deep_hearth_state = {
				owner = {
					zin_deep_is_cold_crown = yes
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = zin_deep_hearth_stone
					}
				}
			}
		}
		var:global.zin_deep_hearth_holder = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
				}
				clr_country_flag = zin_deep_hearth_stone
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_idea = zin_deep_relic_hearth_stone
					}
					remove_ideas = zin_deep_relic_hearth_stone
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.265 }
			}
		}
		var:global.zin_deep_hearth_state = {
			owner = {
				set_country_flag = zin_deep_hearth_stone
				add_ideas = zin_deep_relic_hearth_stone
				set_variable = { global.zin_deep_hearth_holder = THIS }
				if = {
					limit = {
						original_tag = MLK
					}
					set_global_flag = zin_deep_hearth_melkgard
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_deep.265 }
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_deep_hearth_changed_hands
	}
	# Achievement tracking: the Moot of Mothers must never take Parim.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_deep_moot_formed
			NOT = {
				has_global_flag = zin_deep_moot_took_parim
			}
			var:global.zin_deep_site_parim = {
				controller = {
					has_country_flag = zin_deep_moot_of_mothers
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_deep_moot_took_parim
	}
}
